original: atha vāsmābhiḥ paralokaprasādhakapramāṇaparyanuyogo 'numānādinā svatantraprasiddhaprāmāṇyena, parābhyupagamāv agataprāmāṇyena vā kriyate kiṃ tarhi yadi paralokādiko 'tīndriyo 'rthaḥ pareṇābhyupagamyate tadā tatpratipādakaṃ pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam, pramāṇanibandhanā hi prameyavyavasthitiḥ, tasya ca pramāṇasya tallakṣaṇādyasambhavena
analyzed: atha vā asmābhiḥ para loka prasādhaka pramāṇa paryanuyogaḥ numāna ādinā svatantra prasiddha prāmāṇyena para abhyupagamau agata prāmāṇyena vā kriyate kim tarhi yadi para loka ādikaḥ tīndriyaḥ rthaḥ pareṇa abhyupagamyate tadā tad pratipādakam pramāṇam vaktavyam pramāṇa nibandhanā hi prameya vyavasthitiḥ tasya ca pramāṇasya tad lakṣaṇa ādi asambhavena

original: tadviṣayābhimatasyāpy abhāvaḥ ity evaṃvicāraṇālakṣaṇaḥ paryanuyogaḥ kriyata iti na svatantrānumānopanyāsapakṣadharmyasiddhyādilakṣaṇadoṣāvakāśo bṛhaspatimatānusāriṇāṃ; nanv evam apy anayā bhaṅgyā bhavatā paralokādyatīndriyārthaprasādhakapramāṇaparyanuyoge prasaṅgasādhanākhyam anumānam tadviparyayasvarūpaṃ ca svavācaiva pratipāditaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: tad viṣaya abhimatasya api abhāvaḥ iti evam vicāraṇā lakṣaṇaḥ paryanuyogaḥ kriyate iti na svatantra anumāna upanyāsa pakṣa dharmya siddhi ādi lakṣaṇa doṣa avakāśaḥ bṛhaspati mata anusāriṇām nanu evam api anayā bhaṅgyā bhavatā para loka ādi atīndriya artha prasādhaka pramāṇa paryanuyoge prasaṅga sādhana ākhyam anumānam tad viparyaya svarūpam ca sva vācā eva pratipāditam bhavati

original: tathā hi – pramāṇanibandhanā prameyavyavasthitiḥ ity evaṃ vadatā prameyavyavasthā pramāṇanimittaiva pratipāditā bhavati; etac ca prasaṅgasādhanam, tac ca vyāpyavyāpakabhāve siddhe yatra vyāpyābhyupagamo vyāpakābhyupagamanāṇtarīyakaḥ pradarśyate ity evaṃlakṣaṇam, tena prameyavyavasthā pramāṇapravṛttyā vyāptā pramāṇato bhavatā pradarśanīyā;
analyzed: tathā hi pramāṇa nibandhanā prameya vyavasthitiḥ iti evam vadatā prameya vyavasthā pramāṇa nimittā eva pratipāditā bhavati etat ca prasaṅga sādhanam tat ca vyāpya vyāpaka bhāve siddhe yatra vyāpya abhyupagamaḥ vyāpaka abhyupagamana āṇtarīyakaḥ pradarśyate iti evaṃlakṣaṇam tena prameya vyavasthā pramāṇa pravṛttyā vyāptā pramāṇataḥ bhavatā pradarśanīyā

original: anyathā pramāṇapravṛttim antareṇāpi prameyavyavasthā syāt | tataś ca kathaṃ paralokādisādhakapramāṇaparyanuyoge 'pi paralokavyavasthā na bhavet ? vyāpyavyāpakabhāvagrāhakapramāṇābhyupagame ca kathaṃ kāryahetoḥ svabhāvahetor vā paralokādiprasādhakatvena pravartamānasya pratikṣepaḥ vyāptiprasādhakapramāṇasadbhāve 'numānapravṛtter anāyāsasiddhatvāt ?
analyzed: anyathā pramāṇa pravṛttim antareṇa api prameya vyavasthā syāt tatas ca katham para loka ādi sādhaka pramāṇa paryanuyoge pi para loka vyavasthā na bhavet vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva grāhaka pramāṇa abhyupagame ca katham kārya hetoḥ svabhāva hetoḥ vā para loka ādi prasādhaka tvena pravartamānasya pratikṣepaḥ vyāpti prasādhaka pramāṇa sadbhāve numāna pravṛtteḥ anāyāsa siddha tvāt

original: pramāṇābhāve tannibandhanāyāḥ prameyavyavasthāyā apy abhāva iti prasaṅgaviparyayaḥ; sa ca vyāpakābhāve vyāpyasyāpy abhāvaḥ ity evambhūtavyāpakānupalabdhisamudbhūtānumānasvarūpaḥ |
analyzed: pramāṇa abhāve tad nibandhanāyāḥ prameya vyavasthāyāḥ api abhāvaḥ iti prasaṅga viparyayaḥ sa ca vyāpaka abhāve vyāpyasya api abhāvaḥ iti evambhūta vyāpaka anupalabdhi samudbhūta anumāna svarūpaḥ

original: etad api prasaṅgaviparyayarūpam anumānaṃ pramāṇato vyāpyavyāpakabhāvasiddhau pravartata iti vyāptiprasādhakasya pramāṇasya tatprasādalabhyasya cānumānasya prāmāṇye svavācaiva bhavatā dattaḥ svahasta iti nānumānādiprāmāṇyapratipādane 'smābhiḥ prayasyate |
analyzed: etat api prasaṅga viparyaya rūpam anumānam pramāṇataḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva siddhau pravartate iti vyāpti prasādhakasya pramāṇasya tad prasāda labhyasya ca anumānasya prāmāṇye sva vācā eva bhavatā dattaḥ sva hastaḥ iti na anumāna ādi prāmāṇya pratipādane smābhiḥ prayasyate

original: ato yad uktam sarvatra paryanuyogaparāṇy eva sūtrāṇi bṛhaspateḥ iti, tad abhidheyaśūnyam iva lakṣyate uktanyāyāt |

analyzed: yat tu uktam pratyakṣām sannihita viṣaya tvena cakṣuḥ ādi prabhavam para loka ādi grāhaka tvena na pravartate tat na siddha sādhanam yat ca uktam na api atīndriyam yogi pratyakṣam para loka vat tasya asiddheḥ iti tat vismaraṇa śīlasya bhavataḥ vacanam atīndriya artha pravṛtti pravaṇasya yogi pratyakṣasya anantaram eva pratipādita tvāt

original: svasaṃvedanāvabhāsabhede saty api na tatpratibhāsasya nīlajñānasya bhedaḥ; nanu kuto nīlajñānasyābhedaḥ kiṃ tatsvasaṃvedanābhedāt, svato vā ? yadi svasaṃvedanābhedāt, tad ayuktam; tadbhedasya vyavasthāpitatvāt | atha svata eva tadabhedaḥ, tad apy ayuktam; tasyādyāpy asiddhatvāt |
analyzed: sva saṃvedana avabhāsa bhede sati api na tad pratibhāsasya nīla jñānasya bhedaḥ nanu kutas nīla jñānasya abhedaḥ kim tad sva saṃvedanā bhedāt svatas vā yadi sva saṃvedanā bhedāt tat ayuktam tad bhedasya vyavasthāpita tvāt atha svatas eva tad abhedaḥ tat api ayuktam tasya adya api asiddha tvāt

original: tathā, yadi darśanāvasthāyāṃ sparśanāvasthā na pratibhātīti tadavasthāvyāptir darśanajñānenāvasthātur na grahītuṃ śakyā; nanv evaṃ tadapratibhāsane tena tadavyāptir api kathaṃ graḥituṃ śakyā ? tadapratibhāsane tata idam avasthātṛrūpaṃ vyāvṛttam ity etad api prahītum aśakyam eva |
analyzed: tathā yadi darśana avasthāyām sparśana avasthā na pratibhāti iti tad avasthā vyāptiḥ darśana jñānena avasthātuḥ na grahītum śakyā nanu evam tad apratibhāsane tena tad avyāptiḥ api katham graḥitum śakyā tad apratibhāsane tatas idam avasthātṛ rūpam vyāvṛttam iti etat api prahītum aśakyam eva

original: na ca tadviviktapratibhāsād eva tadavyāptir gṛhītaiveti vaktuṃ yuktam, tadapratibhāsane tadviviktasyaivāgrahaṇāt | na ca tadavyāptis  tasya svarūpam eva iti darśanajñānena tatsvarūpagrāhiṇā tadabhinnasvarūpā tadavyāptir api gṛhītaiveti yuktam, tadvyāptāv apy asya sarvasya samānatvāt | na cābādhitaikapratyayaviṣayasyātmana ekatvam asiddham |
analyzed: na ca tad vivikta pratibhāsāt eva tad avyāptiḥ gṛhītā eva iti vaktum yuktam tad apratibhāsane tad viviktasya eva agrahaṇāt na ca tad avyāptiḥ tasya svarūpam eva iti darśana jñānena tad svarūpa grāhiṇā tad abhinna svarūpā tad avyāptiḥ api gṛhītā eva iti yuktam tad vyāptau api asya sarvasya samāna tvāt na ca abādhita eka pratyaya viṣayasya ātmanaḥ ekatvam asiddham

original: na cāsyaikatvādhyavasāyasya kiñcid bādhakam asti, tadbādhakatvena sambhāvyamānasya pramāṇasya yathāsthānaṃ niṣetsyamānatvāt |
analyzed: na ca asya ekatva adhyavasāyasya kiñcid bādhakam asti tad bādhaka tvena sambhāvyamānasya pramāṇasya yathāsthānam niṣetsyamāna tvāt

original: bhavatu vānusandhānapratyayalakṣaṇād dhetos tadekatvasiddhis tathāpi netatretarāśrayadoṣaḥ, yato naikatvapratibaddham anusandhānam anvayidṛṣṭāntadvāreṇa niścīyate – yenāyaṃ doṣaḥ syāt – api tv anekatve 'nusandhānasyāsambhavāt tato vyāvṛttam anusandhānaṃ tadekatvena vyāpyata ity ekasantāne smaraṇādyanusandhānadarśanād anumānato 'pi tatsiddhiḥ |
analyzed: bhavatu vā anusandhāna pratyaya lakṣaṇāt hetoḥ tad ekatva siddhiḥ tathā api na itatra itara āśraya doṣaḥ yatas na ekatva pratibaddham anusandhānam anvayi dṛṣṭānta dvāreṇa niścīyate yena ayam doṣaḥ syāt api tu anekatve nusandhānasya asambhavāt tatas vyāvṛttam anusandhānam tad ekatvena vyāpyate iti eka santāne smaraṇa ādi anusandhāna darśanāt tad ekatvena vyāpyate iti eka santāne smaraṇa ādi anusandhāna darśanāt tad siddhiḥ

original: na ca bhede darśanasmaraṇādijñānānām anusandhānaṃ sambhavati; anyathā devadattānubhūte 'rthe yajñadattasya smaraṇādyanusandhānaṃ syāt |
analyzed: na ca bhede darśana smaraṇa ādi jñānānām anusandhānam sambhavati anyathā devadatta anubhūte rthe yajñadattasya smaraṇa ādi anusandhānam syāt

original: atha devadattayajñadattayor ekasantānābhāvaṃ nānusandhānam, yatra tv ekaḥ santānas tatra pūrvāparajñānayor atyantabhede 'pi bhavaty evānusandhānam; nanu santānasya yadi santānibhyo bhedaḥ ekatvaṃ ca tadā śabdāntareṇa sa evātmābhihito yatpratibaddham anusandhānam |
analyzed: atha devadatta yajñadattayoḥ eka santāna abhāvam na anusandhānam yatra tu ekaḥ santānaḥ tatra pūrva apara jñānayoḥ atyanta bhede bhavati eva anusandhānam nanu santānasya yadi santānibhyaḥ bhedaḥ eka tvam ca tadā śabda antareṇa saḥ eva ātmā abhihitaḥ yat pratibaddham anusandhānam

original: atha santānibhyo 'bhinnaḥ santānas tadā pūrvottarajñānakṣaṇānāṃ santāniśabdavācyānāṃ devadattayajñadattajñānavad atyantabhedāt tadabhinnasya santānasyāpi bheda iti kuto 'nusandhānanimittatvam ? athaikasantatipatitānāṃ pūrvottarajñānasantānināṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvād bhede 'py ekasantānatvam tannibandhanaś cānusandhānapratyayo yuktaḥ, na punar
analyzed: atha santānibhyaḥ bhinnaḥ santānaḥ tadā pūrva uttara jñāna kṣaṇānām santāni śabda vācyānām devadatta yajñadatta jñāna vat atyanta bhedāt tad abhinnasya santānasya api bhedaḥ iti kutas nusandhāna nimitta tvam atha eka santati patitānām pūrva uttara jñāna santāninām kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt bhede pi eka santāna tvam tad nibandhanaḥ ca anusandhāna pratyayaḥ yuktaḥ na punar

original: devadattayajñadattajñānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva atas tannibandhanasantānābhāvanimittas tatrānusandhānābhāvaḥ; nanu devadattajñānaṃ yajñadattena yadā vyāpāravyāhārādiliṅgabalād anumīyate tadā tad yajñadattānumānajanakaṃ bhavatīti kāryakāraṇabhāvanimittaikasantānanibandhanānusandhānaprasaktiḥ syāt |
analyzed: devadatta yajñadatta jñānayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ atas tad nibandhana santāna abhāva nimittaḥ tatra anusandhāna abhāvaḥ nanu devadatta jñānam yajñadattena yadā vyāpāra vyāhāra ādi liṅga balāt anumīyate tadā tat yajñadatta anumāna janakam bhavati iti kārya kāraṇa bhāva nimitta eka santāna nibandhana anusandhāna prasaktiḥ syāt

original: atha svasantatāv upādānopādeyabhāvena jñānānāṃ janyajanakabhāvaḥ bhinnasantatau tu sahakāribhāvena tadbhāva iti nāyaṃ doṣaḥ; nanu kiṃ punar idam upādānatvaṃ yadabhāvād bhinnasantāne 'nusandhānābhāvaḥ ? yat svasantatinivṛttau kāryaṃ janayati tad upādānakāraṇam, yathā mṛtpiṇḍaḥ svayaṃ nivartamāno ghaṭam utpādayatīti sa ghaṭotpattāv upādānakāraṇaṃ;
analyzed: atha sva santatau upādāna upādeya bhāvena jñānānām janya janaka bhāvaḥ bhinna santatau tu sahakāri bhāvena tad bhāvaḥ iti na ayam doṣaḥ nanu kim punar idam upādāna tvam yad abhāvāt bhinna santāne nusandhāna abhāvaḥ yat sva santati nivṛttau kāryam janayati tat upādāna kāraṇam yathā mṛd piṇḍaḥ svayam nivartamānaḥ ghaṭam utpādayati iti sa ghaṭa utpattau upādāna kāraṇam

original: atha vāparam – anekasmād utpadyamāne kārye svagataviśeṣādhāyakaṃ tat, na tv evaṃ nimittakāraṇam | nanu pratikṣaṇaviśarāruṣv ekasvabhāvapaurvāparyāvasthitajñānasyabhāveṣu kṣaṇeṣūpādānopādeyabhāva eva na vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyaḥ |
analyzed: atha vā aparam anekasmāt utpadyamāne kārye svagata viśeṣa ādhāyakam tat na tu evam nimitta kāraṇam nanu prati kṣaṇa viśarāruṣu eka svabhāva paurvāparya avasthita jñāna sya bhāveṣu kṣaṇeṣu upādāna upādeya bhāvaḥ eva na vyavasthāpayitum śakyaḥ

original: tathā hi – uttarajñānaṃ janayat pūrvajñāmaṃ kiṃ naṣṭaṃ janayati, utānaṣṭam, ubhayarūpam, anubhayarūpam vā ? na tāvan naṣṭam, cirataraanaṣṭasyevānantaranaṣṭasyāpy avidyamānatvenotpādakatvavirodhāt | nāpy anaṣṭam, kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt | nāpy ubhayarūpam, ekasvabhāvasya vuruddhobhayarūpāsambhavāt |
analyzed: tathā hi uttara jñānam janayat pūrva jñāmam kim naṣṭam janayati uta anaṣṭam ubhaya rūpam anubhaya rūpam vā na tāvat naṣṭam ciratara anaṣṭasya iva anantara naṣṭasya api avidyamāna tvena utpādaka tva virodhāt na api anaṣṭam kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅga prasaṅgāt na api ubhaya rūpam eka svabhāvasya vuruddha ubhaya rūpa asambhavāt

original: nāpy anubhayarūpam, anyonyavyavacchedarūpāṇām ekaniṣedhasya tadaparavidhānanāntarīyakatvenānubhayarūpatāyā ayogāt |
analyzed: nā api anubhaya rūpam anyonya vyavaccheda rūpāṇām eka niṣedhasya tad apara vidhāna nāntarīyaka tvena anubhaya rūpa tāyāḥ ayogāt

original: atha yadi vyāpārayogāt kāraṇaṃ kāryotpādakam abhyupagamyeta tadā syād ayaṃ doṣaḥ – yad uta naṣṭasya vyāpārāsambhavāt kathaṃ kāryotpādakatvam, yadā tu prāgbhāvamātram eva kāraṇasya kāryotpādakatvaṃ tadā kuta etaddoṣāvasaraḥ ? nanv etasminn abhyupagame prāgbhāvino 'nekasmād upajāyamāne kārye kuto 'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ -
analyzed: atha yadi vyāpāra yogāt kāraṇam kārya utpādakam abhyupagamyeta tadā syāt ayam doṣaḥ yat uta naṣṭasya vyāpāra asambhavāt katham kārya utpādaka tvam yadā tu prāgbhāva mātram eva kāraṇasya kārya utpādaka tvam tadā kutas etad doṣa avasaraḥ nanu etasmin abhyupagame prāk bhāvinaḥ na ekasmāt upajāyamāne kārye kutas yam vibhāgaḥ

original: idam atropādānakāraṇam idaṃ ca sahakārikāraṇam iti, dvayor api kāreṇānuvihitānvayavyatirekatvāt ? atha saty apy anvayavyatirekānuvidhāne ekasyopādānatvena janakatvam aparasyānyatheti; nanv etad evopādānabhāvena janakatvaṃ kasyacid rūpasyānanugame prāgbhāvitvamātreṇa duravaseyam |
analyzed: idam atra upādāna kāraṇam idam ca sahakāri kāraṇam iti dvayoḥ api kāreṇa anuvihita anvaya vyatireka tvāt atha sati api anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāne ekasya upādāna tvena janaka tvam aparasya anyathā iti nanu etat eva upādāna bhāvena janaka tvam kasyacid rūpasya ananugame prāgbhāvi tva mātreṇa duravaseyam

original: athābhihitam evopādānakāraṇatvasya lakṣaṇaṃ tadavagamāt kathaṃ tad duravaseyam | satyam, uktam na tu kasyacid rūpasyānanugame tat sambhavati | nāpy avasāntuṃ śakyam |
analyzed: atha abhihitam eva upādāna kāraṇa tvasya lakṣaṇam tad avagamāt katham tat duravaseyam satyam uktam na tu kasyacid rūpasya ananugame tat sambhavati na api avasāntum śakyam

original: tathā hi – yat svagataviśeṣādhāyakatvam upādānatvam uktaṃ tat kiṃ svagatakatipayaviśeṣādhāyakatvam, āhosvit sakalaviśeṣādhāyakatvam iti ? tatra yadi prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ, sa na yuktaḥ; sarvajñajñāne svākārārpakasyāsmadādivijñānasya taṃ pratyupādānabhāvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: tathā hi yat svagata viśeṣa ādhāyaka tvam upādāna tvam uktam tat kim svagata katipaya viśeṣa ādhāyaka tvam āhosvit sakala viśeṣa ādhāyaka tvam iti tatra yadi prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ sa na yuktaḥ sarvajña jñāne sva ākāra arpakasya asmat ādi vijñānasya tam prati upādāna bhāva prasaṅgāt

original: tathā, rūpasyāpi rūpajñānaṃ pratyupādānabhāvaprasaktiḥ, tasyāpi svagatakatipayaviśeṣādhāyakatvāt; anyathā nirākārasya bodhasya sarvān praty aviśeṣād rūpasyaivāyaṃ grāhako na rasādeḥ iti tataḥ pratikarmavyavasthā na syāt | rūpopādānatve ca jñānasya paralokāya datto jalāñjaliḥ syāt |
analyzed: tathā rūpasya api rūpa jñānam prati upādāna bhāva prasaktiḥ tasya api svagata katipaya viśeṣa ādhāyaka tvāt anyathā nirākārasya bodhasya sarvān prati aviśeṣāt rūpasya eva ayam grāhakaḥ na rasa ādeḥ iti tatas prati karma vyavasthā na syāt rūpa upādāna tve ca jñānasya para lokāya dattaḥ jala añjaliḥ syāt

original: kiñ ca, katipayaviśeṣādhāyakatvenopādānatve ekasyaiva jñānakṣaṇasya tatkāryānugatavyāvṛttānekadharmasambandhitvābhyupagame viruddhadharmādhyāso 'bhyupahato bhavati; tathā ca yathā yugapadbhāvyanekaviruddhadharmādhyāse 'py ekaṃ vijñānaṃ tathā kramabhāvyanekataddharmayoge kim ity ekaṃ nābhyupagamyeta ?
analyzed: kim ca katipaya viśeṣa ādhāyaka tvena upādāna tve ekasya eva jñāna kṣaṇasya tad kārya anugata vyāvṛtta aneka dharma sambandhi tva abhyupagame viruddha dharma adhyāsaḥ bhyupahataḥ bhavati tathā ca yathā yugapad bhāvi aneka viruddha dharma adhyāse pi ekam vijñānam tathā krama bhāvi aneka tad dharma yoge kim iti ekam na abhyupagamyeta

original: atha sakalaviśeṣādhāyakatvena, na tarhi nirvikalpakāt savikalpakotpattiḥ | na ca nirvikalpakayor apy upādānopādeyatvenābhyupagatayos tadbhāvaḥ syāt, tathā ca kuto rūpākārāt samanantarapratyayāṭ kadācid rasādyākārasyāpy upādeyatvenābhimatasyotpattiḥ ?
analyzed: atha sakala viśeṣa ādhāyaka tvena na tarhi nirvikalpakāt savikalpaka utpattiḥ na ca nirvikalpakayoḥ api upādāna upādeya tvena abhyupagatayoḥ tad bhāvaḥ syāt tathā ca kutas rūpa ākārāt kadācid rasa ādi ākārasya api upādeya tvena abhimatasya utpattiḥ

original: atha vijñānasantānabahutvābhyupagamād nāyaṃ doṣaḥ – tena sarvasya svasadṛśasyotpattiḥ – tarhy asmin darśane ekasminn api santāne pramātṛnānātvaprasaṅgaḥ; tathā ca gavāśvadarśanayor bhinnasantānavarttinor ekena dṛṣṭe 'rthe 'parasyānusandhānaṃ na syāt, devadattayajñadattasantānagatayor ivānyenānubhūte 'nyasya | dṛśyate ca
analyzed: atha vijñāna santāna bahu tva abhyupagamāt na ayam doṣaḥ tena sarvasya sva sadṛśasya utpattiḥ tarhi asmin darśane ekasmin api santāne pramātṛ nānātva prasaṅgaḥ tathā ca gava aśva darśanayoḥ bhinna santāna varttinoḥ ekena dṛṣṭe rthe parasya anusandhānam na syāt devadatta yajñadatta santāna gatayoḥ iva anyena anubhūte nyasya dṛśyate ca

original: gām ahaṃ jñātavān pūrvam aśvaṃ jānāmy ahaṃ punaḥ [ŚV ātma 122]
analyzed: gām aham jñātavān pūrvam aśvam jānāmi aham punar

original: kiñ ca, sakalasvagataviśeṣādhāyakatve sarvātmanopādeyajñānakṣaṇe tasyopayogād anupayuktasyāparasvabhāvasyābhāvād yogivijñānam rūpādikaṃ caikasāmagryantargataṃ prati na sahakāritvaṃ tasyeti sahakārikāraṇābhāve nopādeyakṣaṇavyatiriktakāryāntarotpādaḥ |
analyzed: kiñ ca sakala svagata viśeṣa ādhāyaka tve sarva ātmanā upādeya jñāna kṣaṇe tasya upayogāt anupayuktasya apara svabhāvasya abhāvāt yogi vijñānam rūpa ādikam ca eka sāmagrī antargatam prati na sahakāri tvam tasya iti sahakāri kāraṇa abhāve na upādeya kṣaṇa vyatirikta kārya antara utpādaḥ

original: atha yeṣāṃ kāraṇam eva kāryatayā pariṇamati  teṣāṃ bhavatv ayaṃ diṣo na tv asmākaṃ prāgbhāvamātraṃ kāraṇatvam abhyupagacchatām | nanv atrāpi mate yena svarūpeṇavijñānam upādeyaṃ vijñānāntaraṃ janayati kiṃ tenaiva rūpam ekasāmagryantargatam, uta svabhāvāntareṇa ? tatra yadi tenaiva tadā rūpam api jñānam upādeyabhūtaṃ syāt, tatsvabhāvajanyatvāt;
analyzed: atha yeṣām kāraṇam eva kārya tayā pariṇamati teṣām bhavatu ayam diṣaḥ na tu asmākam prāc bhāva mātram kāraṇa tvam abhyupagacchatām nanu atra api mate yena sva rūpeṇa vijñānam upādeyam vijñāna antaram janayati kim tena eva rūpam eka sāmagrī antargatam uta svabhāva antareṇa tatra yadi tena eva tadā rūpam api jñānam upādeya bhūtam syāt tad svabhāva janya tvāt

original: taduttarajñānakṣaṇavat | atha svabhāvāntareṇa tadopādānābhimataṃ jñānaṃ dvisvabhāvam āsajyates | yathā copādānasahakārisvabhāvarūpadvayayogas tathā trailokyāntargatānyajanyakāryāntarāpekṣayā tasyājanakatvam api svabhāvaḥ;
analyzed: tad uttara jñāna kṣaṇa vat atha svabhāva antareṇa tadā upādāna abhimatam jñānam dvi svabhāvam yathā ca upādāna sahakāri svabhāva rūpa dvaya yogaḥ tathā trailokya antargata anya janya kārya antara apekṣayā tasya ajanaka tvam api svabhāvaḥ

original: tataś caikatvaṃ jñānakṣaṇasya yathopādānasahakāryajanakatvānekaviruddhadharmādhyāsitasyābhyupagamyate tathā harṣaviṣādādyanekavivarttātmanas tatsantānasyāpy abhyupagantavyam | athopādānasahakāryajanakatvādayo dharmās tatra kalpanāśilpakalpitāḥ;
analyzed: tatas ca ekatvam jñāna kṣaṇasya yathā upādāna sahakārya janakatva aneka viruddha dharma adhyāsitasya abhyupagamyate tathā harṣa viṣāda ādi aneka vivartta ātmanaḥ tad santānasya api abhyupagantavyam atha upādāna sahakārya janakatva ādayaḥ dharmāḥ tatra kalpanā śilpa kalpitāḥ

original: ekatvaṃ tu tasya svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddham iti na tais tad apanīyata iti matis tarhy ātmano 'py ekatvaṃ santānaśabdābhidheyatayā prasiddhasya svasaṃvedanādhyakṣasiddhasya kramavad dharṣaviṣādādikāryadarśanānumīyamānatadapekṣajanakatvājanakatvadharmāpaneyaṃ na syāt | tan na svagatasakaladharmādhāyakatvam upādānatvaṃ bhavadabhyupagamena saṅgatam |

original: {tathā hi – avayavirūpaṃ tāvat tanvādi avabhāsamānatanu na yuktam; deśādibhinnasya tanvādeḥ sthūlasyaikasyānupapatteḥ | na hy anekadeśādigatam ekaṃ bhavituṃ yuktam, viruddhadharmādhyāsasya bhekalakṣaṇatvāt – deśādibhedaya ca viruddhadharmarūpatvāt | tathāpy abhede sarvatra bhinnatvenābhyupagate ghaṭapaṭādāv api bhedoparatiprasaṅgāt;

original: tan na prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ | nāpi dvitīyaḥ, yataḥ vyāpyābhyupagamo yatra vyāpakābhyupagamanāntarīyakaḥ pradarśyate tat prasaṅgasādhanam | na ca parasya bhedaviruddhadharmādhyāsayor vyāpyavyāpakabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ, deṣādibhedalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsābhāve 'pi rūparasayor bhedābhyupagamāt |

original: tadbhāve 'pi sāmānyādāv abhedasya pramānasiddhatvād iti na vaktavyam |

analyzed: yatas prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ tāvat anabhyupagamāt eva nirastaḥ prasaṅga sādhana pakṣe tu yat dūṣaṇam abhihitam deśa bheda lakṣaṇa viruddha dharma adhyāsa abhāve pi rūpa rasayoḥ bhedaḥ iti tat vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva aparijñānam sūcayati na punar vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva abhāvam yatas deśa bhede sati yadi kaścid siddhaḥ syāt tadā vyāpaka abhāve pi

original: viruddhadharmādhyāsasya bhāvān na tasya tena vyāptiḥ syāt; yadā tu deśābhede 'pi rūparasayor bhedas tadā deśabhedo bhedavyāpako na syāt | na punar etāvatā bhedo viruddhadharmādhyāsavyāpako na syāt | yadi hi bhedavyāvṛttāv api deśādibhedo na vyāvarteta tadā vyāpakavyāvṛttāv api vyāpyasyāvyāvṛttena bhedena deśādiviruddhadharmādhyāso vyāpyeta;
analyzed: viruddha dharma adhyāsasya bhāvāt na tasya tena vyāptiḥ syāt yadā tu deśa abhede rūpa rasayoḥ bhedaḥ tadā deśa bhedaḥ bheda vyāpakaḥ na syāt na punar etāvatā bhedaḥ viruddha dharma adhyāsa vyāpakaḥ na syāt yadi hi bheda vyāvṛttau api deśa ādi bhedaḥ na vyāvarteta tadā vyāpaka vyāvṛttau api vyāpyasya a vyāvṛttena bhedena deśa ādi viruddha dharma adhyāsaḥ vyāpyeta

original: na caitat kvacid api siddham | yat tu sāmāṇyādāv abhedasya pramāṇataḥ siddher bhedavyāvṛttāv api na deṣādibhedalakṣaṇasya viruddhadharmādhyāsasya nivṛttiḥ iti, tad ayuktam; sāmānyādeḥ pramāṇato 'bhinnarūpasyāsiddheḥ | uktaṃ ca -

original: yadi viruddhadharmādhyāsaḥ padārthānāṃ bhedako na syāt tadānyasya tadbhedakasyābhāvād viśvam ekaṃ syāt [   ] pratibhāsabhedasyāpi tam antareṇa bhedavyavasthāpakasyābhāvād iti vyāpyavyāpakabhāvasiddheḥ kathaṃ na prasaṅgasādhanasyātrāvakāśaḥ ?

original: athaikatvapratibhāsād deśādibhede 'pi tanvāder ekatā, na; deśabhedena vyavasthitānām avayavānāṃ pratibhāsabhedena bhedāt; na hy ekarūpā bhāgā bhāsante, piṇḍasyāṇumātratāpatteḥ: tadvyatiriktasya cāparasya tanvādyavayavino dravyasyopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasyānupalambhenāsattvāt | na ca tasyopalabdhilakṣanaprāptatā parair nābhyupagamyate |
analyzed: atha eka tva pratibhāsāt deśa ādi bhede pi tanu ādeḥ ekatā na deśa bhedena vyavasthitānām avayavānām pratibhāsa bhedena bhedāt na hi eka rūpāḥ bhāgāḥ bhāsante piṇḍasya aṇu mātra tā āpatteḥ tad vyatiriktasya ca aparasya tanu ādi avayavinaḥ dravyasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalambhena asattvāt na ca tasya upalabdhi lakṣana prāpta tā paraiḥ nā abhyupagamyate

original: atha mandamandaprakāśe avayavapratibhāsam antareṇāpy avayavini pratibhāsa upalabhyate tat kathaṃ pratibhāsābhāvāt tasyābhāvah ? asad etat; na hi tathābhūto 'spaṣṭapratibhāso 'vayavisvarūpavyavasthāpako yuktaḥ, tatpratibhāsasyāspaṣṭarūpasya spaṣṭajñānāvabhāsitatsvarūpeṇa virodhāt | atha svasrūpadvayam etad avayavinaḥ – spaṣṭam aspaṣṭaṃ ca |
analyzed: atha manda manda prakāśe avayava pratibhāsam antareṇa api avayavini pratibhāsaḥ upalabhyate tat katham etat na hi tathābhūtaḥ spaṣṭa pratibhāsaḥ vayavi svarūpa vyavasthāpakaḥ yuktaḥ tad pratibhāsasya aspaṣṭa rūpasya spaṣṭa jñāna avabhāsi tad svarūpeṇa virodhāt atha sva srūpa dvayam etat avayavinaḥ spaṣṭam aspaṣṭam ca

original: atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, tathāsati spaṣṭasvarūpasambandhitvam eva, aspaṣṭasya viśadasvarūpānupraviṣṭatvena pratibhāsanāt | tan na svarūpadvayāvagamo 'vayavinaḥ | ekatvapratibhāsanaṃ tu pratibhāsarahitam abhimānamātraṃ spaṣṭāspaṣṭarūpayoḥ; anyathā sālokajñānavad mandālokajñānam api parisphuṭapratibhāsaṃ syāṭ |
analyzed: atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ tathā asati spaṣṭa sva rūpa sambandhi tvam eva aspaṣṭasya viśada sva rūpa anupraviṣṭa tvena pratibhāsanāt tat na sva rūpa dvaya avagamaḥ vayavinaḥ ekatva pratibhāsanam tu pratibhāsa rahitam abhimāna mātram spaṣṭa aspaṣṭa rūpayoḥ anyathā sāloka jñāna vat manda āloka jñānam api parisphuṭa pratibhāsam syāṭ

original: athālokabhāvābhāvakṛtas tatra spaṣṭāspaṣṭapratibhāsabhedaḥ; nanv ālokenāpy avayavisvarūpam evodbhāsanīyam, tac ced avikalaṃ mandāloke pratibhāti kathaṃ na tatra tadavabhāsakṛtaḥ spaṣṭāvabhāsaḥ ? anyathā viṣayā, avabhāsavyatirekeṇāpi jñānapratibhāsabhede na jñānāvabhāsabhedo rūparasayor api bhedavyavasthāpakaḥ syāt |
analyzed: atha āloka bhāva abhāva kṛtaḥ tatra spaṣṭa aspaṣṭa pratibhāsa bhedaḥ nanu ālokena api avayavi svarūpam evā udbhāsanīyam tat ced avikalam manda āloke pratibhāti katham na tatra tad avabhāsa kṛtaḥ spaṣṭa avabhāsaḥ anyathā viṣayāḥ avabhāsa vyatirekeṇa api jñāna pratibhāsa bhede na jñāna avabhāsa bhedaḥ rūpa rasayoḥ api bheda vyavasthāpakaḥ syāt

original: athāvayavisvarūpam ekam evobhayatra pratīyate, vyaktāvyaktākārau tu jñānasyātmanāv ity ucyeta tad apy asat; yato yadi jñānākārau tau katham avayavirūpatayā pratibhātaḥ ? tadrūpatayā ca pratibhāsanād avayavyākārau tāv abhyupagantavyau | na hi vyaktarūpatām avyaktarūpatāṃ ca muktvā avayavisvarūpam aparam ābhāti | tat tasyānavabhāsād abhāva eva |
analyzed: atha avayavi svarūpam ekam evā ubhayatra pratīyate vyakta avyakta ākārau tu jñānasya ātmanau iti ucyeta tat api asat yatas yadi jñāna ākārau tau katham avayavi rūpa tayā pratibhātaḥ tad rūpa tayā ca pratibhāsanāt avayavi ākārau tau abhyupagantavyau na hi vyakta rūpa tām avyakta rūpa tām ca muktvā avayavi sva rūpam aparam ābhāti tat tasya anavabhāsāt abhāvaḥ eva

original: vyaktāvyaktaikātmanaś cāvayavino vyaktāvyaktākāravad bhedaḥ | na hi pratibhāsabhede 'py ekatā, atiprasaṅgāt | tan na aspaṣṭapratibhāsam andhakāre 'vayavino rūpam avayavāpratibhāse 'pi pratibhātīti vaktuṃ yuktam, uktadoṣaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: vyakta avyakta eka ātmanaḥ ca avayavinaḥ vyakta avyakta ākāra vat bhedaḥ na hi pratibhāsa bhede pi ekatā atiprasaṅgāt tat na aspaṣṭa pratibhāsam andhakāre vayavinaḥ rūpam avayava apratibhāse pi pratibhāti iti vaktum yuktam ukta doṣa prasaṅgāt

original: kiñca, kiṃ katipayāvayavapratibhāsi sati avayavī pratibhātīty abhyupagamyate, āhosvit samastāvayavapratibhāse ? yady ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ, sa na yuktaḥ; jalamagnamahākāyastambhāder uparitanakatipayāvayavapratibhāse 'pi samastāvayavavyāpinaḥ stambhādyavayavino 'pratibhāsanāt | atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ, so 'pi na yuktaḥ;
analyzed: kiñca kim katipaya avayava pratibhāsi sati avayavī pratibhāti iti abhyupagamyate āhosvit samasta avayava pratibhāse yadi ādyaḥ pakṣaḥ sa na yuktaḥ jala magna mahākāya stambha ādeḥ uparitana katipaya avayava pratibhāse samasta avayava vyāpinaḥ stambha ādi avayavinaḥ pratibhāsanāt atha dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ saḥ pi na yuktaḥ

original: madhyaparabhāgavarttisamastāvayavapratibhāsāsambhavenāvayavino 'pratibhāsaprasaṅgāt | atha bhūyovayavagrahaṇe sati avayavī gṛhyata ity abhyupagamaḥ, so 'pi na yuktaḥ; yato 'rvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavagrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa parabhāgabhāvyavayavāgrahaṇād na tena tadvyāptir avayavino grahītuṃ śakyā; vyāpyāgrahaṇe tena tadvyāpakatvasyāpi grahītum aśakteḥ;
analyzed: madhya para bhāga vartti samasta avayava pratibhāsa asambhavena avayavinoḥ pratibhāsa prasaṅgāt atha bhūyas vayava grahaṇe sati avayavī gṛhyate iti abhyupagamaḥ saḥ pi na yuktaḥ yatas rvāc bhāga bhāvi avayava grāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa parabhāga bhāvi avayava agrahaṇāt na tena tad vyāptiḥ avayavinaḥ grahītum śakyā vyāpya agrahaṇe tena tad vyāpaka tvasya api grahītum aśakteḥ

original: grahaṇe vātiprasaṅgaḥ | tathā hi – yad yena rūpeṇa avabhāti tat tenaiva rūpeṇa sad iti vyavahāraviṣayaḥ -
analyzed: grahaṇe vā atiprasaṅgaḥ tathā hi yat yena rūpeṇa avabhāti tat tena eva rūpeṇa sat iti vyavahāra viṣayaḥ

original: yathā nīlaṃ nīlarūpatayā pratibhāsamānaṃ tenaiva rūpeṇa tadviṣayaḥ, arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhitayā cāvayavī pratibhātīti svabhāvahetuḥ | na ca parabhāgabhāvivyavahitāvayavāpratibhāsane 'py avyavahito 'vayavī pratibhātīti vaktuṃ śakyam, tad pratibhāsane tadgatatvenāpratibhāsanāt |
analyzed: yathā nīlam nīla rūpa tayā pratibhāsamānam tena eva rūpeṇa tad viṣayaḥ arvāk bhāga bhāvi avayava sambandhi tayā ca avayavī pratibhāti iti svabhāva hetuḥ na ca parabhāga bhāvi vyavahita avayava apratibhāsane pi avyavahitaḥ vayavī pratibhāti iti vaktum śakyam tat pratibhāsane tadgata tvena apratibhāsanāt

original: yasmiṃś ca pratibhāsamāne yad rūpaṃ na pratibhāti, tat tato bhinnam – yathā ghaṭe pratibhāsamāne 'pratibhāsamānaṃ paṭasvarūpam | na pratibhāti ca arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhyavayavisvarūpe pratibhāsamāne parabhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhyavayavisvarūpam iti kathaṃ na tat tato bhinnam ? tathāpy abhede 'tiprasaṅgaḥ pratipāditaḥ |
analyzed: yasmin ca pratibhāsamāne yat rūpam na pratibhāti tat tatas bhinnam yathā ghaṭe pratibhāsamāne pratibhāsamānam paṭa sva rūpam na pratibhāti ca arvāk bhāga bhāvi avayava sambandhi avayavi sva rūpe pratibhāsamāne para bhāga bhāvi avayava sambandhi avayavi sva rūpam iti katham na tat tatas bhinnam tathā api abhede tiprasaṅgaḥ pratipāditaḥ

original: nāpi parabhāgabhāvyavayavāvayavigrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhitvaṃ tasya gṛhyate, tatra tadavayavānāṃ pratibhāsāt tatsambandhy evāvayavisvarūpaṃ pratibhāseta nārvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhi; teṣāṃ tatrāpratibhāsanāt | tadpratibhāsane ca tatsambandhirūpasyāpy apratibhāsanāt, vyāpyāpratipattau tadvyāpakatvasyāpy apratipatteḥ |
analyzed: nā api parabhāga bhāvi avayava avayavi grāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa arvāc bhāga bhāvi avayava sambandhi tvam tasya gṛhyate tatra tad avayavānām pratibhāsāt tad sambandhi evā avayavi svarūpam pratibhāseta na arvāc bhāga bhāvi avayava sambandhi teṣām tatra apratibhāsanāt tad pratibhāsane ca tad sambandhi rūpasya api apratibhāsanāt vyāpya apratipattau tad vyāpaka tvasya api apratipatteḥ

original: nāpi smaraṇena arvākparabhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhyavayavisvarūpagrahaḥ, pratyakṣānusāreṇa samaraṇasya pravṛttyupapatteḥ; pratyakṣasya ca tadgrāhakatvaniṣedhāt | nāpy ātmā arvākparabhāgāvayavavyāpitvam avayavino gragītum samarthaḥ – sattāmātreṇa tasya tadgrāhakatvānupapatteḥ;
analyzed: nā api smaraṇena arvāk parabhāga bhāvi avayava sambandhi avayavi svarūpa grahaḥ pratyakṣa anusāreṇa samaraṇasya pravṛtti upapatteḥ pratyakṣasya ca tad grāhaka tva niṣedhāt nā api ātmā arvāk parabhāga avayava vyāpi tvam avayavinaḥ samarthaḥ sattā mātreṇa tasya tad grāhaka tva anupapatteḥ

original: anyathā svāpamadamūrcchādyavasthāsv api tatpratipattiprasaṅgāt – kintu darśanasahāyaḥ; tac ca darśanaṃ na avayavino 'vayavavyāptigrāhakaṃ pratyakṣādikaṃ sambhavatīti pratipāditam |
analyzed: anyathā svāpa mada mūrcchā ādi avasthāsu api tad pratipatti prasaṅgāt kintu darśana sahāyaḥ tat ca darśanam na avayavinaḥ vayava vyāpti grāhakam pratyakṣa ādikam sambhavati iti pratipāditam

original: athārvāgbhāgadarśane saty uttarakālaṃ parabhāgadarśane 'nantarasmaraṇasahakārīndriyajanitaṃ sa evāyam iti pratyabhijñājñānam adhyakṣam avayavinaḥ pūrvāparāvayavavyāptigrāhakam, tad ayuktam; pratyabhijñājñānasyaitadviṣayasya pratyakṣatvānupapatteḥ |

original: akṣānusāri hi pratyakṣam, na cākṣānām arvākparabhāgabhāvyavayavagrahaṇe vyāpāraḥ sambhavati, vyavahite teṣāṃ vyāpārāsambhavāt; sambhave vātivyavahite 'pi merupṛṣṭhādau vyāpāraḥ syāt | tan na tadanusāriṇo 'dhyakṣarūpasya pratyabhijñājñānasya tatra vyāpāraḥ |

original: na ca smaraṇasahāyasyāpīndriyasyāviṣaye vyāpāraḥ sambhavati, yad yasyāviṣayaḥ na tat tara smaraṇasahāyam api pravartate – yathā parimalasmaraṇasahāyam api locanaṃ gandhādau, aviṣayaś ca vyavahito 'kṣāṇāṃ parabhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhitvalakṣaṇo 'vayavinaḥ svabhāva iti nākṣajasya pratyabhijñājñānasyāvayavisvarūpagrāhakatvam |

original: na ca sa evāyam iti pratītir ekā, saḥ iti smṛteḥ rūpam, ayam iti tu dṛśaḥ svarūpam | tat parokṣāparokṣākāratvād naikasvabhāvāv etau pratyayau | atha sa evāyam ity ekādhikāraṇatayā etau pratibhāta iti ekaṃ pratyabhijñājñānam, na; ākārabhede sati darśanasmaraṇayor iva sāmānādhikaraṇyādhyavasāye 'py ekatvānupapatteḥ |

analyzed: atha yat tadā tatra avidyamānam artham avaiti jñānam tatra viparīta khyātiḥ pratyakṣa pratītiḥ tu pūrva saṅghānāt api upajāyamānā puras sat eva vastu gṛhṇatī katham viparīta khyātiḥ bhavet nanu purva rūpa tā hitayā tasyāḥ sat artha grahaṇam eva na sambhavati

original: smaraṇopaneyaṃ hi rūpaṃ pratiyatī vartamānatayā pratyakṣabuddir na pratibhāsamānavapuṣaḥ sattāṃ sādhayitum akṣam, pratyastamite 'pi rūpe smṛter avatārāt | tadanusāriṇī cākṣamatir api tad evānusarantī na sattāspadam |
analyzed: smaraṇa upaneyam hi rūpam pratiyatī vartamāna tayā pratyakṣa buddiḥ na pratibhāsamāna vapuṣaḥ sattām sādhayitum akṣam pratyastamite rūpe smṛteḥ avatārāt tad anusāriṇī ca akṣa matiḥ api tat eva anusarantī na sattā āspadam

original: tasmād indriyamatiḥ sakalā pūrvarūpagrahaṇaṃ pariharantī vartamāne parisphuṭe vartata iti tadaiva tadgatāṃ jātim udbhāsayituṃ prabhur iti na pūrvāparavyaktigatā jātiḥ samasti | yad eva hi dvitīyavyaktigataṃ rūpaṃ bhāti tad eva sat, pūrvavyaktigataṃ tu rūpaṃ na abhātīti nan tat sat |
analyzed: tasmāt indriya matiḥ sakalā pūrva rūpa grahaṇam pariharantī vartamāne parisphuṭe vartate iti tadā eva tad gatām jātim udbhāsayitum prabhuḥ iti na pūrva apara vyakti gatā jātiḥ samasti yat eva hi dvitīya vyakti gatam rūpam bhāti tat eva sat pūrva vyakti gatam tu rūpam na tat sat

original: tataś cānekavyaktivyāpikāyā jāter siddhir iti na tatra liṅgaśabdayor api pravṛttir iti na tābhyām api tatpratipattiḥ | yathā ca vyaktibhinnānusyūtā jātir na sambhavati tathā yathāsthānaṃ pratipādayiṣyata ity āstāṃ tāvat |
analyzed: tatas ca aneka vyakti vyāpikāyāḥ jāteḥ siddhiḥ iti na tatra liṅga śabdayoḥ api pravṛttiḥ iti na tābhyām api tad pratipattiḥ yathā ca vyakti bhinna anusyūtā jātiḥ na sambhavati tathā yathāsthānam pratipādayiṣyate iti āstām tāvat

original: tad evaṃ sattāsamavāyayoḥ paraparikalpitayor asiddheḥ prāgasataḥ kāraṇasamavāyaḥ sattāsamavāyo vā kāryatvam iti kāryatvasyāsiddhatvāt svarūpāsiddho 'pi kāryatvalakṣaṇo hetuḥ } |
analyzed: tat evam sattā samavāyayoḥ para parikalpitayoḥ asiddheḥ prāk asataḥ kāraṇa samavāyaḥ sattā samavāyaḥ vā kārya tvam iti kārya tvasya asiddha tvāt svarūpa asiddhaḥ api kārya tva lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ

original: atha syād eṣa doṣo yadi yathoktalakṣaṇaṃ karyatvaṃ hetutvenopanyastaṃ syāt, yāvatābhūtvā bhavanalakṣaṇaṃ kāryatvaṃ hetutvenopanyastaṃ tenāyam adoṣaḥ |
analyzed: atha syāt eṣa doṣaḥ yadi yathā ukta lakṣaṇam karya tvam hetu tvena upanyastam syāt yāvatā a bhūtvā bhavana lakṣaṇam kārya tvam hetu tvena upanyastam tena ayam adoṣaḥ

original: nanv evam api bhūbhūdharādeḥ katham evaṃbhūtaṃ kāryatvaṃ siddham ? atha yadi atra vipratipattiviṣayatā tadānumānatas teṣu kāryatvaṃ sādhyate, tac cānumānam – bhūbhūdharāyaḥ kāryam, racanāvattvāt, ghaṭādivat iti kathaṃ na teṣu kāryatvalakṣaṇo hetuḥ siddhaḥ ? asad etat;
analyzed: nanu evam api bhūbhūdhara ādeḥ katham evaṃbhūtam kāryatvam siddham atha yadi atra vipratipatti viṣaya tā tadā anumānataḥ teṣu kāryatvam sādhyate tat ca anumānam bhūbhūdhara ayaḥ kāryam racanāvat tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti katham na teṣu kāryatva lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ siddhaḥ asat etat

original: yato 'trāpi prayoge bhūbhūdharāder avayavino 'siddher āśrayāsiddhaḥ racanāvattvāt iti hetuḥ, tadasiddhatvaṃ ca prāk pratipāditam |
analyzed: prayoge bhū bhūdhara ādeḥ siddheḥ āśraya asiddhaḥ racanā vat tvāt iti hetuḥ tad asiddha tvam ca prāk pratipāditam

original: kiñca, {yadi avayavasanniveśo racanā tadvattvaṃ ca pṛthivyādes tadutpādyatvam tadāvayavasanniveśasya saṃyogāparanāmno 'siddhatvād asiddhaviśeṣaṇo racanāvattvād iti hetuḥ | tathā, pṛthivyādiṣu samyogajanyatvasya viśeṣyasyāsiddhatvād asiddhaviśeṣaś ca prakṛto hetuḥ |
analyzed: kiñca yadi avayava sanniveśaḥ racanā tadvattvam ca pṛthivī ādeḥ tad utpādya tvam tadā avayava sanniveśasya saṃyoga apara nāmnaḥ siddhatvāt asiddha viśeṣaṇaḥ racanāvattvāt iti hetuḥ tathā pṛthivī ādiṣu samyoga janya tvasya viśeṣyasya asiddha tvāt asiddha viśeṣaḥ ca prakṛtaḥ hetuḥ

original: kathaṃ saṃyogāsiddhatvam yenoktadoṣāduṣṭaḥ prakṛto hetuḥ syāt ? ucyate, tadgrāhakapramāṇābhāvāt bādhakapramāṇopapatteś ca | tathā hi -
analyzed: katham saṃyoga asiddha tvam yena ukta doṣa aduṣṭaḥ prakṛtaḥ hetuḥ syāt ucyate tad grāhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt bādhaka pramāṇa upapatteḥ ca tathā hi

original: [prāsaṅgikaṃ saṃyogasya nirasanam]
analyzed: prāsaṅgikam saṃyogasya nirasanam

original: saṅkhyāparimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyogavibhāgau paratvāparatve karma ca rūpi(dravya)samavāyāc cākṣāṇi [VS 4.1.11]
analyzed: saṅkhyā parimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgau paratva aparatve karma ca rūpi dravya samavāyāt ca akṣāṇi

original: iti vacanāt dṛśyavastusamavetasya saṃyogasya pareṇa pratyakṣagrāhyatvam abhyupagatam | na ca niranarotpannavastudvayapratibhāsakālo 'dhyakṣapratipattau tadvyatirekeṇa paraḥ saṃyogo bahirgrāhyarūpatāṃ vibhrāmaḥ pratibhāti, nāpi kalpanabuddhau vastudvayaṃ yathoktaṃ vihāya śabdollekhaṃ cāntaram aparaṃ varṇākṛtyakṣarākārarahitaṃ saṃyogasvarūpam
analyzed: iti vacanāt dṛśya vastu samavetasya saṃyogasya pareṇa pratyakṣa grāhya tvam abhyupagatam na ca niḥ anara utpanna vastu dvaya pratibhāsa kālaḥ dhyakṣa pratipattau tad vyatirekeṇa paraḥ saṃyogaḥ bahis grāhya rūpa tām vibhrāmaḥ pratibhāti na api kalpana buddhau vastu dvayam yathā uktam vihāya śabda ullekham ca antaram aparam varṇa ākṛti akṣara ākāra rahitam saṃyoga svarūpam

original: udbhāti | tad evam upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya saṃyogasyānupalabdher bhāvah, śaśaviṣāṇavat |
analyzed: udbhāti tat evam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya saṃyogasya anupalabdheḥ śaśa viṣāṇa vat

original: tena yad āha uddyotakaraḥ
analyzed: tena yat āha uddyota karaḥ

original: yadi saṃyogo nārthāntaraṃ bhavet tadā kṣetrabījodakādayo nirviśiṣṭatvāt sarvadaivāṅkurādikāryaṃ kuryuḥ, na caivam, tasmāt sarvadā kāryānārambhāt kṣetrādīny aṅkurotpattau karaṇāntarasāpekṣāṇi, yathā mṛtpiṇḍādisāmagrī ghaṭādikaraṇe kulālādisāpekṣā; yo 'sau kṣetrādibhir apekṣyaḥ sa saṃyoga iti siddham |
analyzed: yadi saṃyogaḥ nā artha antaram bhavet tadā kṣetra bīja udaka ādayaḥ niḥ viśiṣṭa tvāt sarvadā eva aṅkura ādi kāryam kuryuḥ na ca evam tasmāt sarvadā kārya anārambhāt kṣetra ādīni aṅkura utpattau karaṇa antara sāpekṣāṇi yathā mṛd piṇḍa ādi sāmagrī ghaṭa ādi karaṇe kulāla ādi sāpekṣā sa asau kṣetra ādibhiḥ apekṣyaḥ sa saṃyogaḥ iti siddham

original: kiñca, asau saṃyogo dravyayor viśeṣanabhāvena pratīyamānatvāt tato 'rthāntaratvena pratyakṣasiddha eva | tathā hi – kaścit kenācit saṃyukte dravye āhara ity ukto yayor eva dravyayoḥ saṃyogam upalabhate te evāharati na dravyamātram |
analyzed: kiñca asau saṃyogaḥ dravyayoḥ viśeṣana bhāvena pratīyamāna tvāt tatas rtha antara tvena pratyakṣa siddhaḥ eva tathā hi kaścid kenācid saṃyukte dravye āhara iti uktaḥ yayoḥ eva dravyayoḥ saṃyogam upalabhate te eva āharati na dravya mātram

original: kiñca, dūrataravartinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntare 'pi vane nirantararūpāvasāsinī buddhir udayām āsādayati, seyaṃ mithyābuddhiḥ mithyapadārthānubhavam antareṇa na kvacid upajāyate | na hy ananubhūtagodarśanasya gavaye gauḥ iti vibhramo bhavati | tasmād avaśyaṃ saṃyogo mukhyo 'bhyupagantavyaḥ |
analyzed: kiñca dūratara vartinaḥ puṃsaḥ sāntare vane nirantara rūpa avasāsinī buddhiḥ udayām āsādayati sā iyam mithyā buddhiḥ mithyā padārtha anubhavam antareṇa na kvacid upajāyate na hi ananubhūta go darśanasya gavaye gauḥ iti vibhramaḥ bhavati tasmāt avaśyam saṃyogaḥ mukhyaḥ bhyupagantavyaḥ

original: tathā, na caitraḥ kuṇḍalī ity anena pratiṣedhavākyena na kuṇḍalaṃ pratiṣidhyate, nāpi caitraḥ, tayor anyatra deśādau sattvāt | tasmāc caitrasya kuṇḍalasaṃyogaḥ pratiṣidhyate | tathā, caitraḥ kuṇḍalī ity anenāpi vidhivākyena na caitrakuṇḍalayor anyataravidhānam, tayoḥ siddhatvāt; pāriśeṣyāt samyogavidhānam |
analyzed: tathā na caitraḥ kuṇḍalī iti anena pratiṣedha vākyena na kuṇḍalam pratiṣidhyate na api caitraḥ tayoḥ anyatra deśa ādau sattvāt tasmāt caitrasya kuṇḍala saṃyogaḥ pratiṣidhyate tathā caitraḥ kuṇḍalī iti anena api vidhi vākyena na caitra kuṇḍalayoḥ anyatara vidhānam tayoḥ siddha tvāt pāriśeṣyāt samyoga vidhānam

original: tasmād asty eva saṃyogaḥ [NV 219] iti, tannirastaṃ draṣṭavyam; saṃyuktadravyasvarūpāvabhāsavyatirekeṇāparasya saṃyogasya pratyakṣe nirvikalpake sanikalpake vāparitabhāsasya pratipāditatvāt |
analyzed: tasmāt asti eva saṃyogaḥ NM iti tat nirastam draṣṭavyam saṃyukta dravya sva rūpa avabhāsa vyatirekeṇa aparasya saṃyogasya pratyakṣe nirvikalpake sa nikalpake vā aparita bhāsasya pratipādita tvāt

original: na ca saṃyuktapratiyayānyathānupapattyā samyogakalpanopapannā, nirantarāvasthayor eva bhāvayoḥ saṃyuktapratyayahetutvāt |
analyzed: na ca saṃyukta pratiyayā anyathā anupapattyā samyoga kalpanā upapannā nirantara avasthayoḥ eva bhāvayoḥ saṃyukta pratyaya hetu tvāt

original: yāvac ca tasyām avasthāyāṃ saṃayogajanakatvena saṃyuktapratyayaviṣayau tāv iṣyete tāvat samyogam antareṇa saṃyuktapratyayahetutvena tadviṣayau kiṃ neṣyete pāramparyeṇa ? na ca sāntare vane nirantarāvabhāsinī buddhir mukhyapadārthānubhavapūrvikā, askhalatpratyayatvenānupacaritatvāt |
analyzed: yāvat ca tasyām avasthāyām saṃayoga janaka tvena saṃyukta pratyaya viṣayau tau iṣyete tāvat samyogam antareṇa saṃyukta pratyaya hetu tvena tad viṣayau kim na iṣyete pāramparyeṇa na ca sāntare vane nirantara avabhāsinī buddhiḥ mukhya padārtha anubhava pūrvikā a skhalat pratyaya tvena anupacarita tvāt

original: na caitraḥ kuṇḍalī ityādau caitrasambandhikuṇḍalaṃ niṣidhyate vidhīyate vā na saṃyogaḥ | na ca sambandhavyatirekeṇa caitrasya kuṇḍalasambandhānupapattir iti vaktuṃ śakyam, yataś caitrakuṇḍalayoḥ kiṃ sambandhinoḥ sa sambandhaḥ, utāsambandhinoḥ ? nāsambandhinoḥ, himavadvindhyayor ivāsambandhinoḥ sambandhānupapatteḥ;
analyzed: na caitraḥ kuṇḍalī ityādau caitra sambandhi kuṇḍalam niṣidhyate vidhīyate vā na saṃyogaḥ na ca sambandha vyatirekeṇa caitrasya kuṇḍala sambandha anupapattiḥ iti vaktum śakyam yatas caitra kuṇḍalayoḥ kim sambandhinoḥ sa sambandhaḥ uta asambandhinoḥ na asambandhinoḥ himavat vindhyayoḥ iva asambandhinoḥ sambandha anupapatteḥ

original: na cāsambandhinor bhinnasambandhena tadabhinnaṃ sambandhitvaṃ śakyaṃ vidhātum, viruddhadharmādhyāsena bhedāt | nāpi bhinnam, tatsadbhāve 'pi tayoḥ svarūpeṇāsambandhitvaprasaṅgāt; bhinnasya tatkṛtopakāram antareṇa  tatsambandhitvāyogāt; tato 'paropakārakalpane 'navasthāprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: na ca asambandhinoḥ bhinna sambandhena tat abhinnam sambandhi tvam śakyam vidhātum viruddha dharma adhyāsena bhedāt nā api bhinnam tad sadbhāve pi tayoḥ svarūpeṇa asambandhi tva prasaṅgāt bhinnasya tad kṛta upakāram antareṇa tad sambandhi tva ayogāt para upakāra kalpane navasthā prasaṅgāt

original: sambandhinos tu sambandhaparikalpanaṃ vyartham, sambandham antareṇāpi tayoḥ svata eva sambandhisvarūpatvāt |
analyzed: sambandhinoḥ tu sambandha parikalpanam vyartham sambandham antareṇa api tayoḥ svatas eva sambandhi svarūpa tvāt

original: yat tūktam viśiṣṭāvasthāvyatirekeṇa kṣitibījodakādīnāṃ nāṅkurajanakatvam, sā ca viśiṣṭāvasthā teṣāṃ saṃyogarūpā śaktiḥ, tad asāram; yato yathā viśiṣṭāvasthāyuktāḥ kṣityādayaḥ saṃyogam utpādayanti tathā tadavasthāyuktā aṅkurādikam api kāryam niṣpādayiṣyantīti vyarthaṃ saṃyogaśaktes tadantarālavartinyāḥ parikalpanam |
analyzed: yat tu uktam viśiṣṭa avasthā vyatirekeṇa kṣiti bīja udaka ādīnām na aṅkura janaka tvam sā ca viśiṣṭa avasthā teṣām saṃyoga rūpā śaktiḥ tat asāram yatas yathā viśiṣṭa avasthā yuktāḥ kṣiti ādayaḥ saṃyogam utpādayanti tathā tad avasthā yuktāḥ aṅkura ādikam api kāryam niṣpādayiṣyanti iti vyartham saṃyoga śakteḥ tad antarāla vartinyāḥ parikalpanam

original: atha saṃyogaśaktivyatirekena na kāryotpādane kāraṇakalāpaḥ pravartata iti nirbandhas tarhi saṃyogaśaktyutpādane 'py aparasamyogaśaktivyatirekeṇa vāsau pravartata ity aparā saṃyogaśaktiḥ parikalpanīyā, tatrāpy aparety anavasthā |
analyzed: atha saṃyoga śakti vyatirekena na kārya utpādane kāraṇa kalāpaḥ pravartate iti nirbandhaḥ tarhi saṃyoga śakti utpādane pi apara samyoga śakti vyatirekeṇa vā asau pravartate iti aparā saṃyoga śaktiḥ parikalpanīyā tatra api aparā iti anavasthā

original: atha tām antareṇāpi śaktim utpādayanti tarhi kāryam api tām antareṇaivāṅkurādikaṃ nirvartayiṣyantīti vyarthaṃ saṃyogaśaktes tadantarālavartinyāḥ kalpanam | na ca viśiṣṭāvasthāvyatirekeṇa pṛthivyādayaḥ saṃyogaśaktim api nirvartayituṃ kṣamāḥ; tathābhyupagame sarvadā tannirvartanaprasaṅgād aṅkurāder apy anavaratotpattiprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: atha tām antareṇa api śaktim utpādayanti tarhi kāryam api tām antareṇa eva aṅkura ādikam nirvartayiṣyanti iti vyartham saṃyoga śakteḥ tad antarāla vartinyāḥ kalpanam na ca viśiṣṭa avasthā vyatirekeṇa pṛthivī ādayaḥ saṃyoga śaktim api nirvartayitum kṣamāḥ tathā abhyupagame sarvadā tad nirvartana prasaṅgāt aṅkura ādeḥ api anavarata utpatti prasaṅgaḥ

original: na cānyatarakarmādisavyapekṣāḥ saṃyogam utpādayanti kṣityādaya iti nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, karmotpattāv api samyogapakṣoktadūṣaṇasya sarvasya tulyatvāt | tasmād ekasāmagryadhīnaviśiṣṭotpattimatpadārthavyatirekeṇa nāparaḥ saṃyogaḥ, tasya bādhakapramāṇaviṣayatvāt sādhakapramāṇābhāvāc ca |
analyzed: na ca anyatara karma ādi savyapekṣāḥ saṃyogam utpādayanti kṣiti ādayaḥ iti na ayam doṣaḥ karma utpattau api samyoga pakṣa ukta dūṣaṇasya sarvasya tulya tvāt tasmāt eka sāmagrī adhīna viśiṣṭa utpattimat padārtha vyatirekeṇa na aparaḥ saṃyogaḥ tasya bādhaka pramāṇa viṣaya tvāt sādhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt ca

original: yas tu saṃyukte dravye ete iti anayor vāyaṃ saṃyogaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ sa bhedāntarapratikṣepāpratikṣepābhyāṃ tathāvasthotpannavastudvayanibandhana eva, nāto 'parasya saṃyogasya siddhiḥ | na cākṣaṇikatve tayoḥ sa sambandhī yuktaḥ | tatsambandhasya samavāyasya niṣiddhatvāt niṣetsyamānatvāc ca |
analyzed: yaḥ tu saṃyukte dravye ete iti anayoḥ vā ayam saṃyogaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ sa bheda antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepābhyām tathā avasthā utpanna vastu dvaya nibandhanaḥ eva na atas parasya saṃyogasya siddhiḥ na ca akṣaṇika tve tayoḥ sa sambandhī yuktaḥ tad sambandhasya samavāyasya niṣiddha tvāt niṣetsyamāna tvāt ca

original: bhūruhādikaṃ kartṛkaraṇapūrvakaṃ kadācanāpy upalabdham kintu kāraṇamātrapūrvakam, atas tadabhāve tasya bhavato 'hetukatvaprāptes tad eve tad gamayatīty asakṛd āveditam |

original: yac cābhyadhāyi kāryasya śarīreṇa saha vyabhicāro dṛśyate, svaśarīrāvayavānāṃ hi śarīrāntaram antareṇāpi pravṛttinivṛttī kevalo vidadhāti iti, tad apy ayuktam;

original: yadi ca śarīrarahitasyāpi tasya bhūruhādikārye vyāpāraḥ parikalpyate tahri muktasyāpi tadantareṇa jñānasamavāyikāraṇatvaparikalpanaṃ kiṃ na kriyate ? tathābhyupagame na jñānasukhādiguṇarahitātmasvarūpāvasthitir muktiḥ sambhavati iti tadartham īśvarārādhanam asaṅgatam āsajyeta |
